topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Walking through the campus, the autumn leaves a symphony underfoot, when I stumbled upon a bulletin board, a tapestry of paper dreams. There, among the flyers for lost cats and upcoming lectures, my own words gazed back at me, like a reflection in a misty mirror. My college application essay, a snippet of my soul, was pinned there, exampled, celebrated. It spoke of the quiet moments that shaped me, the whispers of the woods and the silent thunder of books. Seeing it there, surrounded by the sea of faces, I felt a kinship with the words, a connection deeper than ink on paper. They were no longer just mine; they belonged to the air, the season, the young minds passing by.
